mapper.sql: id, request_no, member_id, promotion_relation_id, product_sku_id, receive_address_id, quantity, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, order_id, fail_reason
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_flash_promotion_request (request_no, member_id, promotion_relation_id, product_sku_id, receive_address_id, quantity, idempotency_key, request_hash, status) VALUES (#{requestNo}, #{memberId}, #{promotionRelationId}, #{productSkuId}, #{receiveAddressId}, #{quantity}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, 'INIT')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sms_flash_promotion_request WHERE status='INIT' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM sms_flash_promotion_request WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT FROM sms_flash_promotion_request WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND request_no=#{requestNo}
SELECT FROM sms_flash_promotion_request WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sms_flash_promotion_request WHERE status='RESTORE_PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='PROCESSING' WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status IN ('PUBLISHED','PROCESSING')
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='ORDER_CREATED', order_id=#{orderId}, fail_reason=NULL WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='PAID' WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='ORDER_CREATED'
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='RESTORED' WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='ORDER_CREATED'
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='READY', lease_until=NULL, next_retry_time=NOW() WHERE status='PUBLISHING' AND lease_until < NOW()
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='READY', lease_until=NULL, next_retry_time=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 SECOND) WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='PUBLISHING'
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='RESTORED', lease_until=NULL WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='RESTORE_PENDING'
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='RESTORE_PENDING', fail_reason=#{reason} WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status NOT IN ('PAID','RESTORED')
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='READY', fail_reason=NULL WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='INIT'
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='REJECTED', fail_reason=#{reason} WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='INIT'

UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='PUBLISHING', lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND (status='READY' OR (status='PUBLISHED' AND lease_until <= NOW()))
UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_request SET status='PUBLISHED', lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE request_no=#{requestNo} AND status='PUBLISHING'
